needs.reason: There is no build to evaluate: the only facts are the files and their package declarations.

traps: No build file of any kind: the code is one source-tree unit at the root, with no name and no manifest; no tool should invent a Maven or Gradle project for it.
The source roots src and test can only be inferred from the package declarations (package com.example.tally sits in com/example/tally under each); they are not src/main/java.
test/com/example/tally/CounterCheck.java is a check run through its own main method; there is no test framework and no dependency, only java.util imports.
No Java version is declared anywhere; the code needs Java 8 or later (Map.merge, diamond operator).
